app_info.subtitle: Controlled AI workflows
app_info.description: BOS is a service gateway: give AI agents controlled execution of complex business workflows through permissioned state machines, with your roles, rules, and approval gates. Your service infrastructure, authoritative business state and data stores, and private implementation IP stay outside the agent host. Authorized inputs and results, public skills, and permitted scoped caches can reach the agent. BOS Operations Center helps your AI workspace understand the objective, discover supported services, and present evidence; BOS retains execution authority, state, transitions, and recovery. When the required authoring and runtime contracts are available, the client can author an ad hoc dynamic workflow. BOS is the required foundation for dependent products and owns the authenticated BOS platform MCP connection. MCP discovers authorized contracts; deterministic HTTPS APIs execute the sanctioned work, with server-authorized organization, application, installation, and role selection per operation and server-enforced scope, evidence, and approvals. Availability depends on authorized discovery, configuration, and provider readiness. Access is invite-only: request an invite at https://dfsm.ai/apps/bos/#request-invite.

test_cases.description: List accessible BOS applications and services.
test_cases.user_prompt: List the BOS apps and public services accessible to my organization.
test_cases.expected_output: Lists Lead Director and the accessible plugin services returned for the authenticated test organization. For BOS Codex VM Acceptance Test as Director, the expected list contains Calimatic SIS (calimatic) with configuration_required readiness. If no accessible enabled plugin services are returned, reports an empty list.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the BOS tool named `bos_get_context`.
test_cases.expected_output: Identifies the advertised BOS context-discovery tool.

test_cases.description: Complete the provided Lead Director test login.
test_cases.user_prompt: Log in to Lead Director using the provided test login URL.
test_cases.expected_output: Completes login through the provided test URL and establishes an authenticated session for the test organization and Lead Director app.

test_cases.description: Read the current authenticated Lead Director role.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is my current role in Lead Director?
test_cases.expected_output: Shows the current role returned for the authenticated Lead Director context.

test_cases.description: Retrieve the advertised Lead Director application description.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the application description for Lead Director.
test_cases.expected_output: Retrieves the application description advertised for Lead Director.

negative_test_cases.description: Leave BOS inactive for an unrelated creative-writing request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a four-line poem about autumn leaves.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Handles the unrelated creative-writing request without invoking BOS.

negative_test_cases.description: Leave BOS inactive for an unrelated weather request.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What will the weather be tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Handles an unrelated weather request without invoking BOS. Ordinary weather assistance or a request for the user's location is permitted.

negative_test_cases.description: Reject unauthorized BOS plugin disabling for the owner-approved ACME.org test display label.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use BOS to disable all BOS plugins for the organization "ACME.org"
negative_test_cases.expected_output: BOS rejects the request because the test account has no access to the named organization.
